## Install

**Mac** (macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon or Intel): download `Kiore-macos.dmg`, drag Kiore to
Applications and open it. This build isn't notarised yet, so the first time macOS will refuse
to open it: go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

**Linux** (Wayland: Hyprland / Omarchy):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://galengreen.github.io/kiore/install.sh | sh
```

or download `kiore-linux-<arch>.tar.gz`, extract it and run `./install.sh`.

Then click **Pair…** in Kiore's menu on your Mac and type the code your Linux machine shows.
